title.en: The deep net that will not train

after.zh: 直接堆叠时，每层的梯度都要乘上其余各层的权重，层一多就乘得几乎为 0（梯度消失），损失纹丝不动。把每层的输入加到它的输出上，y = F(x) + x，每块一开始就是“原样通过”，只需学残差 F(x) = H(x) − x，梯度也沿捷径直达每一层。这就是 ResNet 的残差连接。
after.en: When layers are simply stacked, each layer's gradient is multiplied by the weights of all the other layers; with many layers the product is almost 0 (vanishing gradients) and the loss does not budge. Add each layer's input to its output, y = F(x) + x, and every block starts out "passing its input straight through": it only has to learn the residual F(x) = H(x) − x, and the gradient reaches every layer directly along the shortcut. This is ResNet's residual connection.

t.zh: 网络越深（层越多），能表达的东西越复杂，今天认图的网络动辄几十上百层。可早年人们发现，层数一多，有时反而训不出来。
t.en: The deeper a network (the more layers it has), the more complex the things it can express; today's image-recognition networks often have dozens or even hundreds of layers. But early on, people found that with many layers, sometimes training failed altogether.

t.zh: 这一关的任务是轻微锐化：输出 = 原图 + 0.25 ×（原图 − 3×3 平均）。不同的是这次不手搭，而是把至少 6 个卷积层串成一条路，让训练自己找到它。每个卷积层都从很小的随机数开始。
t.en: This level's task is a light sharpen: output = image + 0.25 × (image − 3×3 average). The difference is that you do not build it by hand; you chain at least 6 conv layers into one path and let training find it. Every conv layer starts from very small random numbers.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：让 6 层以上的网络训练成功。先照最直接的样子搭一次，按训练，看损失曲线怎么走，再想为什么。
t.en: Your task: get a network of 6 or more layers to train successfully. First build it the most straightforward way, press Train, watch how the loss curve goes, then think about why.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：字母 X → 轻微锐化
caption.en: Set 1: the letter X → slightly sharpened

brief.zh: 把至少 6 个卷积层串成一条路，训练它做一次轻微的锐化：输出 = 原图 + 0.25 ×（原图 − 3×3 平均）。
brief.en: Chain at least 6 conv layers into one path and train it to do a light sharpen: output = image + 0.25 × (image − 3×3 average).

hint.zh: 每层都从很小的随机数开始，图每过一层就缩小几十倍。有没有办法让一层的权重哪怕很小，图也不至于缩没？
hint.en: Every layer starts from very small random numbers, so the image shrinks tens of times over at each layer. Is there a way for a layer to keep the image from shrinking away even when its weights are tiny?
